cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: This locks in silently ignoring an `input: false` field supplied by the caller: `source: "client"` later becomes the default `"system"`. The existing additional-fields contract says `input: false` prevents callers from passing a value, so this should reject the request, or the SSO docs need to explicitly document the silent-ignore behavior.
